name: Compute Cluster S80: Series Merging (coalesce then ffill)
description: Tests: coalesce() BEFORE ffill for discontinued series. Order matters — first non-null wins.
source:
src = study_assets()()
close = src.c

# Two economic series that may overlap/discontinue
fedfunds = economic_indicators(series_id='FEDFUNDS')().result
dff = economic_indicators(series_id='DFF')().result

# CORRECT: coalesce first (pick best source), THEN ffill
merged_rate = ffill(coalesce(dff, fedfunds))

xy_lines(
    title='Fed Rate (coalesce then ffill)',
    category='Rates',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Merged Rate', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=merged_rate)

summary_table(
    title='Fed Rate Stats',
    category='Rates',
    columns=TableSchema(columns=[
        ColumnSpec(name='Rate', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
    ])
)(merged_rate)
